posts.author: TripleVortex
posts.body:
Hey guys! I’m TripleVortex! (known as SpiraDoubleL on most platforms)
I’ve been using RPG Maker MV for 4 years now, and have a passion for making games. (Although  I’ve never finished a good one)
Although I’m decent at art, music is definitely my strong suite.
I have little to no coding knowledge but I am decently good at RPG Maker’s basic and advanced eventing, so I will try to help anyone I can!
